what: Plan omits the actual shell rebase/re-bump path
scenario_or_breakage: Step 10/12 use scripts/ship-pr.sh run_rebase_rebump, not only the markdown subprocedure; that path would still call drop-bump-commit.sh without --allow-changelog-only and would not create the proposed separate CHANGELOG commit after apply-bump.sh.
suggested_fix: Update scripts/ship-pr.sh to pass --allow-changelog-only at the drop call and add the same CHANGELOG rewrite plus commit-changelog.sh step after successful apply-bump.sh where a bump was created; cover it in test-ship-pr.sh.

what: Plan changes implement-finalize.sh to call commit-changelog.sh but does not update the existing postbump harness
scenario_or_breakage: The sandbox only creates a git-amend-add.sh stub and the failure test is keyed to STUB_AMEND_FAIL, so make test-implement-finalize will invoke a missing commit-changelog.sh or stop testing the failure path.
suggested_fix: Add a commit-changelog.sh stub to the harness, migrate the failure knob/assertion to that helper, and assert the happy path records the separate CHANGELOG commit contract.

what: commit-changelog.sh clean-tree validation is stricter than the existing postbump failure model
scenario_or_breakage: Step 8 larch-log write/commit failures are currently non-fatal, but a helper that refuses any dirty worktree except CHANGELOG.md can turn leftover larch-log dirtiness into STATUS=changelog-failed before Step 8b.
suggested_fix: Scope commit-changelog.sh to refuse staged non-CHANGELOG changes while allowing unrelated unstaged/untracked dirtiness, or explicitly guarantee/clean larch-log dirtiness before calling it.
